selection_review.ranking_protocol: Per-image uncapped mean on common measurable reference items for full and repair-off. Score = (full angle MAE - repair-off angle MAE)/1 degree + (full ratio MRE - repair-off ratio MRE)/0.02. Rank descending, ties by stem.
selection_review.interpretation: The retained cohort is an outcome-selected subset. Its repair ablation is conditional on this selection.
